description: Choose a city and plan daily routes. Add another city when your trip takes you farther. Keep track of packing, expenses, check-ins and photos. Photos stay on your device. Optional AI title suggestions use event times and coordinates.
release_notes: Find cities and airports offline by name, alternate spelling or airport code. Search for sights, food and hotels near either city on a transfer day. Choose a result to add its name and map pin to your itinerary.
